environment.description: EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) running the Flask monolith directly via gunicorn. SELinux is in permissive mode (setenforce 0 was run during initial deployment troubleshooting and never reverted). No WAF or CDN in front. Application is exposed directly on port 8080 via security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 inbound. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured. Browser clients connect directly to the instance public IP.
